changes:
Aurora Debian boot integration: the initrd (dracut) contents and order of alarm-aurora's mkinitcpio hooks, GRUB settings, and the image's unit presets.
update-grub runs Debian's (diverted to update-grub.debian) and then aurora-harden-grub, so a regenerated grub.cfg keeps GRUB's lookups on the startup disk.
notes: alarm-aurora's per-machine pacman keyring service has no Debian counterpart (apt keyrings are public; aurora-archive-keyring ships Aurora's). Debian lacks Arch's 99-default.preset, so this package carries the equivalent disable-everything-else rule.
